verdict.rationale: Programmatic wallet provisioning is a fair question for a crypto payments platform, but the evidence shows no API endpoint for creating per-customer or per-purpose wallets or deposit addresses, and no documented key custody semantics. The one wallet-creation mention (docs-10) describes the hosted widget creating a wallet for an end user from their email during the purchase flow. That is an adjacent, UI-driven feature, not developer API provisioning, so it earns no credit.
